correctness.rationale: The observable is exactly the singleton counts and ordered positions (i,j) with j>=i+2; the streaming signature recurrence is algebraically equivalent to the direct combinatorial count. All binary words up to length seven are exhaustively classified. Projection of each q-ary letter to its binary indicator preserves deck equality. For n6 any changed letter uses exactly three positions and at least two letters change, forcing support two. For n7 changed letters each occupy >=2 positions, so at most 3 change; total union support <=7-m<=5. Exhaustive 5-ary length-seven enumeration is therefore a proof-complete finite base, not an infinite extrapolation; the fibers have size <=2, per-support counts 10 and 15. Relabelling gives the all-q polynomial. Fresh independent code separately enumerated exactly 123,032 words over q2..5 n1..7, obtaining all support histograms and capacities. The length-two composition collision is handled separately.
residual_risks: No claim beyond n=7; the n=7 all-q lift needs the binary support bound, not just a finite sample.
The deck is ordered pair subsequences with one skipped position and singleton multiplicities, not ordinary k-deck or substring spectrum.
